scenes.title: The Aftermath
scenes.summary: Dave wakes beside four people who will not wake. The shoes are impossibly clean.

scenes.title: A Pair in the Bin
scenes.summary: Dave throws the pair away. By morning, Malik finds what looks like a way out.

scenes.title: The First Door
scenes.summary: The shopkeeper recognizes the shoes before Malik understands their reputation.

scenes.title: Rent by Friday
scenes.summary: Mama’s bills and Kiara’s offer show what Malik is trying to escape, and what he could still choose.

scenes.title: The Block Olympics
scenes.summary: An alley competition turns impossible luck into neighborhood fame.

scenes.title: The Promotion
scenes.summary: Mr. GREAT makes the organization look like an employer and Malik look like a recruit.

scenes.title: Legend Tax
scenes.summary: Fear clears the hallway. A $15,000 bag earns Malik $1,000.

scenes.title: New Turf · The Stairwell
scenes.summary: The first new route refuses to make room for Harold and Malik.

scenes.title: New Turf · The Laundry
scenes.summary: Dryers drown out the backroom until the encounter spills into the street.

scenes.title: New Turf · The Fence Lot
scenes.summary: A fenced lot makes the route’s danger impossible to ignore.

scenes.title: New Turf · The Hallway
scenes.summary: Watching neighbors see how little space Malik leaves for anyone else.

scenes.title: Positions
scenes.summary: Malik brings back $25,000 and demands half. The organization answers with its hierarchy.

scenes.title: The Altar
scenes.summary: Harold brings the original pair to Malik’s funeral. The pastor recognizes them.
